name: After § 23
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section IX – European Data Protection Supervisor
part_text: 23 a. Recalls that the EDPS issued a decision on a complaint concerning a targeted advertising campaign conducted by the Commission on the social media platform X; recalls that the EDPS concluded that the Commission had infringed several provisions of Regulation (EU) 2018/1725 by unlawfully processing personal data, including special categories of data such as political opinions and religious beliefs, without a valid legal basis;
